QuestInfo.name: A Surprise Outcome
QuestInfo.1: The piece of paper Moren dropped contained scribbles that seemed like a manual for a Gold Anvil. A Gold Anvil... sounds like something that'd be fun to make. Moren doesn't seem like he wants to make it... so maybe I should try it.\n\n#i4031980# #t4031980# #b#c4031980# / 1
QuestInfo.2: I managed to make a Gold Anvil and gave it to Moren. He seemed astounded by the fact that I was able to make it, and gave me a major praise for being able to do so.

0.0: Do not interrupt me! I'm busy right now!\n\n#L0##bBut Moren, isn't this yours?#l
0.1: Ah, that was just another item gone wrong. It's an item I just can't make, period. If you are interested, then you can go ahead and take it. It might be something worth working on. Anyway I am busy right now, so don't bother me.

yes.0: If you manage to make the item, then bring it to me. Of course, the chance of that happening would be less than 1%.

item.0: If you didn't make the item that was written on that piece of paper, then don't bother me!
